name: WHIST MINNESOTA
description: Partnership trick-taking game with no trumps. Each hand players secretly choose to play high (Grand: take 7+ tricks) or low (Nula: take 6 or fewer) by laying a red or black card; first side to reach the target score (typically 13) wins.

content.text: Partnership trick-taking game with no trumps. Each hand players secretly choose to play high (Grand: take 7+ tricks) or low (Nula: take 6 or fewer) by laying a red or black card; first side to reach the target score (typically 13) wins.
Minnesota Whist was brought to the Upper Midwest by Scandinavian and Norwegian immigrants. It is a simplified Whist with no trumps and optional high (Grand) or low (Nula) play each hand.
Four players in two fixed partnerships; partners sit opposite.
Standard 52-card deck. Rank A K Q J 10 9 8 7 6 5 4 3 2.

One card at a time clockwise from left of dealer until each player has 13 cards.
